hypotheses.J0_full_semantic_chart_span_is_expressiv: The feature-specific 256-chart span reaches at least 0.65 median held-out gradient cosine at every layer.
hypotheses.J1_path_knn_is_useful: Eight-neighbor path retrieval reaches at least 0.20 median gradient cosine at every layer.
hypotheses.J2_path_kernel_router_is_useful: The preregistered alpha-0.1 path kernel router reaches at least 0.35 median gradient cosine at every layer.
hypotheses.J3_path_kernel_beats_feature_mean: The path kernel exceeds the feature mean by at least 0.20 median cosine at every layer.
hypotheses.J4_path_kernel_beats_knn: The path kernel exceeds eight-neighbor retrieval by at least 0.10 median cosine at every layer.
hypotheses.J5_path_kernel_is_not_only_position: Excluding same-position charts reduces path-kernel cosine by at most 0.10 at every layer.
hypotheses.J6_path_kernel_is_finitely_directional: Path-kernel top-64 finite patches increase the semantic score on at least 85 percent of examples at every layer.
hypotheses.J7_path_kernel_preserves_leverage: Path-kernel supports retain at least 30 percent of exact top-64 first-order leverage in the median at every layer.
hypotheses.J8_weight_signature_is_competitive: The attention-pattern kernel is within 0.10 median cosine of the full-path kernel at every layer.
hypotheses.J9_complete_jacobians_improve_sparse_atl: Full-Jacobian path KNN improves by at least 0.10 over the corresponding sparse-atlas path KNN result at every layer.
